tasks.title: Wire the envlint CLI in bin/envlint.mjs
acceptance_criteria: `bin/envlint.mjs` has a `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang and `node --check bin/envlint.mjs` exits 0

acceptance_criteria.text: `envlint --schema <schema.json> <envfile>` reads exactly those two paths, with no implicit `./.env` lookup (covers: REQ-8) (covers: REQ-9)
missing `--schema`, `--schema` with no value, an unknown option, or anything other than one positional → exit 2, stderr `envlint: …` plus a `usage:` line (covers: REQ-22)
findings and parse problems print one per line to stdout, in line order, as `<envfile>:<line>: <KEY>: <message>`, `<envfile>:<line>: <message>` or `<envfile>: <KEY>: <message>` (covers: REQ-2)
exit 0 when nothing is printed, exit 1 when any problem or finding is printed (covers: REQ-3)
the CLI never writes any file and does no dotenv-style loading into `process.env` (covers: REQ-23) (covers: REQ-25)
output has no ANSI escape codes and the CLI never reads stdin (covers: REQ-26)

tasks.title: Add end-to-end CLI tests over fixtures in test/cli.test.mjs
acceptance_criteria: `test/cli.test.mjs` spawns `node bin/envlint.mjs` with fixture files written under `os.tmpdir()`; `npm test` exits 0

acceptance_criteria.text: a missing env file → exit 2, stderr names the path, no stack trace (covers: REQ-4)
a missing schema file, a non-JSON schema and a schema with an unknown `type` → exit 2, stderr names the schema path, no stack trace (covers: REQ-5)
an env file of only comments and blank lines → exit 0 with no required keys; exit 1 with exactly the required-missing line when one key is required (covers: REQ-6)
malformed env input (a line with no `=`, an unterminated quote, binary garbage) never yields a stack trace or an exit code outside {0,1,2} (covers: REQ-7)
run from a temp cwd containing its own `.env`, the output reflects only the given files and no file in the cwd is created or modified (covers: REQ-9) (covers: REQ-23)
